chunks: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Rifah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who forgot to bow (ruku') until he prostrated (sujood) and stood up. He said, 'He faces (the Qibla again).'
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they forget to bow in prayer and only realize it after prostrating?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the procedure for a worshipper who omits the bowing (*ruku'*) and proceeds directly to prostration (*sujood*). The directive to 'face the Qibla' (*yastaqbilu*) indicates that the individual must re-orient themselves to the Qibla before resuming the prayer, ensuring the structural integrity of the missed unit is acknowledged within the ongoing prayer flow. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on maintaining proper orientation and order (*tartib*) even when specific pillars are forgotten, distinguishing it from other schools that might require a full reset or specific compensatory prostrations.
